info.name: USDA FoodData Central
info.description: The USDA endpoints FoodTrack's UsdaFoodDataCentralClient (Infrastructure/Foods) calls or is likely to call next. Requires an environment with `baseUrl` and `apiKey` set -- see usda-fooddata-central.postman_environment.json. Never commit a real apiKey value; keep it in the environment file, which is gitignored.

request.description: Mirrors UsdaFoodDataCentralClient.SearchAsync exactly (same path and query params). Each item in the response's "foods" array carries its nutrients in "foodNutrients" -- verified against a live response that the fields are `nutrientNumber` and `value` (the published OpenAPI spec says `number`/`amount`, which the live API does not actually return). FoodTrack matches on nutrientNumber: 208 = Energy (kcal), 203 = Protein, 204 = Fat, 205 = Carbohydrate; a result missing any of the four is skipped.

Not called by FoodTrack yet -- kept here for inspecting one food's full detail. Its foodNutrients shape differs from the search endpoint: each entry has a nested "nutrient": {id, number, name, unitName} plus a sibling "amount", instead of search's flat nutrientNumber/value.
